description: Check whether the AI crawlers behind ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Apple and Common Crawl can read a website. Tests robots.txt for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended and CCBot, makes a live request as a browser, and reports whether the site publishes llms.txt. Use it when someone asks why AI engines do not mention their site, whether they are blocking ChatGPT or Perplexity, or at the start of any AEO, GEO or AI visibility audit. Reads public pages only; changes nothing.

domain.description: The website to check, like acme.com. A full URL is accepted and reduced to its domain.
domain.title: Domain
